scientific_anchor.endpoint: receiver-week observed detection among response-independently active study receivers
scientific_anchor.forbidden_endpoint: movement to a different receiver; the paper already reports zero valid between-receiver movements

deployment_semantics.study_station_rule: strip station_name outer whitespace; retain acoustic_project_code == AZO and station integer prefix 148 through 157 inclusive with exact suffix FLO CRUZ
deployment_semantics.coordinate_rule: component-wise median deploy_latitude/deploy_longitude across all deployments of the study station
deployment_semantics.active_interval_rule: inclusive calendar dates from deploy_date_time through recover_date_time; missing recovery is treated as open only up to the predeclared study coverage end

eel_metadata_semantics.release_source_rule: for each retained yellow tag, assign the response-independent nearest study receiver to its release latitude/longitude; the unique assigned receiver set is the frozen release-anchor source set
eel_metadata_semantics.latest_release_rule: maximum release_date_time across the 36 predeclared yellow target tags

temporal_design.first_scored_week_rule: first ISO Monday strictly after the calendar date of the latest retained yellow-eel release
temporal_design.full_week_rule: retain only Monday-Sunday weeks fully contained on or before study_coverage_end
temporal_design.heldout_rule: all subsequent full study weeks after the first 26 calibration weeks
temporal_design.heldout_outer_unit: consecutive four-week blocks starting at the first heldout week; a terminal block shorter than four weeks is excluded from the block-win decision but may remain in the pooled heldout log loss

source_process_boundary.observed_sources: study receivers with observed detection in the immediately previous scored week
source_process_boundary.hidden_persistence_source_world: retain the response-independent release-anchor receiver set as a permissive source possibility so weekly non-detection is never equated to biological absence
source_process_boundary.interpretation: release anchors and observed sources define possibilities for the finite world set; no surviving world is identified as historical movement truth

baseline_conventional_feature_boundary: receiver geometry and response-independent active-day effort
calendar week index and cyclic season terms
previous-week observed detection at the focal receiver
previous-week observed source count and distance summaries

no_rescue_rules: do not alter the 148-157 study receiver registry after deployment access
do not use response rows to add or remove receivers or tags
do not switch to between-receiver movement as an endpoint
do not add, delete, or alter the published false-positive exclusions after response access
do not change split, count minima, learner family, score metric, or Layer B after response access
